parameter_matrix.note: Check PCB land pattern & height profile.
A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION PACKAGE HEIGHT/PROFILE: NCP114ASN330T1G (TSOT-23-5) vs TLV75533PDBVR (SOT-23-5) share the same JEDEC land pattern pitch, but thin-profile TSOT (~1.0 mm) vs standard SOT (~1.45 mm) differs in body height; verify enclosure Z-clearance, SMT nozzle height, and solder fillet spec.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: NCP114ASN330T1G supplies up to 300 mA (p.3) compared to TLV75533PDBVR at 500 mA (p.4); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (NCP114ASN330T1G: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TJ) vs TLV75533PDBVR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); NCP114ASN330T1G hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: NCP114ASN330T1G (onsemi, TSOT-23-5) and TLV75533PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because package code differs (TSOT-23-5 vs SOT-23-5; same land pattern, different body profile); Iout,max rating drops >=20%; ambient temperature grade differs (-40..85 °C vs -40..125 °C). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 60.2 °C on NCP114ASN330T1G (θJA 236 °C/W) vs 58.9 °C on TLV75533PDBVR (θJA 231.1 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 2x ratio (50 µA (p.3) vs 25 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: NCP114ASN330T1G "TSOP-5 (TSOT-23-5) Has Worse Dropout (150 mV), Load Reg (28 mV), and RθJA (236 C/W) Than Page-1 UDFN Specs" (p.3) and TLV75533PDBVR "DBV Thermal Resistance (231.1 C/W JEDEC) vs Page-1 Headline 60.3 C/W (DYD Exposed-Pad Only)" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose NCP114ASN330T1G when matching your existing onsemi TSOT-23-5 (SN (TSOP-5 Case 483)) qualification and -40..85 °C grade; choose TLV75533PDBVR when load current exceeds 300 mA (up to 500 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 25 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
